issue_context.title: Inconsistency between validation/errorHandler and serializer causes request timeout
comments:
I think this issue could be related to a new design approach for errors here https://github.com/fastify/fastify/issues/2860
We should definitely define a more clear lifecycle for errors

This issue description is not representative of the bug. The actual bug is that in the 3rd case there is a developer error of a using a required property in the 400 schema definition: the serializer throws an error that is being swallowed.

I think this is a bug that we should be able to handle before https://github.com/fastify/fastify/issues/2860.

review_comments: Just a question, why not template literals here? Something related to performance or just standard style?
Habit I guess. I've never checked the performance of them for converting a number to string.
I personnally did some experiments on fast-json-stringify and those are pretty equivalent
